item.title: [SwiftHFR] docs: LOT-100, 101, 146, 147 and LOT-179 sizes move to M4 as legacy-evolution backports (#655)
item.body:
Refs #655
Refs #237 #236 #191 #192 #419
Claim: mac/m2-lead

## Problem

Operator decisions of 2026-11-09 on #655: LOT-147 (#237) goes to M4 as a whole, and LOT-146 (#236), LOT-100 (#191), LOT-101 (#192) and the cache-sizes half of LOT-179 (#419) go to M4 too. Legacy has them at the reference `2fe43da3` (AGENTS.md §2) and not at `2440d79`. They must be traced as **backports of legacy evolution**, apart from the initial port, the parity fixes, the deliberate gaps and operator or beta feedback. Until now the plan had them in M5 or "milestone pending (#655)".

## Change

- **Milestones** (`tooling/roadmap`): `m5.py` drops 100, 101, 146 and 147 from `MOVED`; `generate.py` drops 100 and 101 from its M2 list (else they would fall back to M2); `lots.json` and `milestones.json` regenerated. Result: M4 gains LOT-100, 101, 146, 147, 179; M5 loses them and gains LOT-187. `test_roadmap.py`: the M5 examples use lots still in M5 (110, 145), and a new test pins the five in M4.
- **LOT-179 split.** Its "clearing" half has no legacy counterpart at `2fe43da3`: `clearCaches` and the "Vider le cache ?" alert exist (`HFRswift/Swift/AppSettingsView.swift:272-286, 637-644`), but `showClearCacheConfirmation` (`:118`) is never set to true, and the ObjC `PlusSettingsViewController` "EmptyCacheButton" (`Classes/PlusSettingsViewController.m:308-313`) is no longer routed. The sizes are there (`:547-577`, `HTMLPageCacheManager.swift:39-55`). So LOT-179 keeps its id and issue for the **sizes (M4)**, and clearing is a new M5 lot, **LOT-187 (#689)**, the (b) half of LOT-120.
- **`docs/LOTS.md`.** Rows of 100, 101, 146, 147, 179 say "backport of legacy evolution" with the `2fe43da3` source, and link their spec. LOT-147 moves from Phase 5 to "Navigation and platform"; LOT-179 from the M5 section to "Settings and appearance"; LOT-187 joins the M5 section; the 120b split row and the M5 paragraph say what moved back and why.
- **Dependencies** (the "no M1–M4 lot depends on an M5 lot" rule, `test_no_lot_of_m1_to_m4_depends_on_an_m5_lot`): LOT-146 and LOT-147 no longer depend on LOT-145 (state restoration per scene, M5). Legacy at `2fe43da3` has no per-scene restoration (one `WindowGroup`, `HFRswift/Swift/HFRswiftApp.swift:24-36`; `git grep 'SceneStorage\|NSUserActivity\|openWindow\|handlesExternalEvents' 2fe43da3 -- HFRswift` is empty), and the fold handoff is an in-memory store (`FoldHandoffStore.swift:11-88`). They depend on LOT-170 (the root they widen or repeat, done) instead. LOT-100 also depends on LOT-088 (legacy offers the poll in the first-post edit too). LOT-164, the parity gate, depends on 100, 101, 146, 147 and 179 again.
- **Specs**, scope at `2fe43da3` with file:line read by `git show 2fe43da3:<path>`: new stubs `LOT-100-poll-creation.md`, `LOT-101-archived-drafts.md`, `LOT-146-multi-window.md`, `LOT-187-cache-clearing.md`; `LOT-147` (whole lot in M4, orientation, inline-title and refresh-icon workarounds, reply button, what is not in the lot: the FEAT-016 rail and pinned sidebar, which legacy lacks and which have no lot) and `LOT-179` (sizes only). `@ 2440d79` citations are kept; the `2fe43da3` ones are added next to them. One-line follow-ups in `LOT-084` (archived drafts are now LOT-101), `LOT-170`, `LOT-186`, `FEATURES.md` (FEAT-016) and `ROADMAP.md` (M5 scope, and the rule that legacy evolution is M4).
- **Tracing.** The GAP rows of these lots get the new `Source` value `port: legacy evolution (2fe43da3)` with H.1 `a·master` (absent at `2440d79`, present at `2fe43da3`); their legacy cells keep the `2440d79` text and add the `2fe43da3` one. All GAP changes are in the ledger below; the description of the new `Source` value and the stale sentences of the report are `ledger-note` entries (the report's header is not a row, so the steward applies them by hand).

Why this wide: the five lots, their GAP rows, and what the move forces (the LOT-179 split, the M5 dependency rule, the parity gate). Not here: status labels (see below), the GAP rows of LOT-170 (211, 212, 214, 218), the `docs/ux/` survey snapshots.

## Tests

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_*.py'`: 128 tests OK. `test_legacy_evolution_backports_are_in_m4` fails on the base (the five are M5 there); `test_an_m5_lot_without_a_credited_pr_is_not_offered_for_a_hand_unblock` used LOT-100 as its "moved M5 lot" and failed with the move until switched to LOT-110.
- `python3 scripts/check-lot-deps.py` (167 lots, 0 violations), `python3 tooling/docs/fold.py --check`, `ledger.py guard`, `ledger.py check-body` on this body, `pre-commit run --all-files`: all pass.

## Issues

`#237`, `#236`, `#191`, `#192`, `#419`: title suffix "(M4)" and a `Milestone:` line under the Summary; `#419` is renamed "Cache sizes" (clearing is `#689`). Status labels unchanged: `#237`, `#236` and `#192` stay `status: blocked` although every dependency is done (reported to the lead); `#191` waits on capture #170; `#419` on LOT-120 (#211).
